tasks.title: Retry a reflected mistake before revealing previous work

scopeCorrection.reason: There is not enough real-use evidence to justify a fixed review interval. JPL-003 uses an explicit manual review queue and defers scheduling until at least five real retries exist.

scope: mark a reflected attempt as needing another try
start a fresh retry from a manual review queue
show the exercise while hiding the previous attempt, mistake and lesson
require a new attempt before revealing prior work
append the retry to the same attempt and persist it locally
load schema-version-2 records and write schema version 3
outOfScope: AI hints, generated answers or grading
fixed intervals, due dates, notifications or spaced repetition
mistake taxonomy, scores, streaks or analytics
accounts, backend, cloud database or sync
acceptance: the learner can manually mark a reflected attempt for retry

a non-empty fresh attempt is required before prior material is revealed

the retry and manual-review state survive a full reload
schema-version-2 records load without data loss and new writes use schema version 3
